about: Where client work is looked for, and what each channel permits. 'fetch' sources are read automatically through a published feed or official API only. Every other source is account-based: leads arrive by notification email or your import, proposals are prepared for you to submit (mode B) unless the platform's own terms permit automation (mode A). Unknown = not permitted (fail closed). Fiverr and Upwork are excluded by your instruction.
